semantics.rust_signature: fn tensor_expand_as_exact_native(input: &Tensor, other: &Tensor, cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<Tensor, ShapeLayoutTransformPartOneError>
semantics.alias_rule: Task 63 read-only zero-stride view shares input storage only
semantics.shape_rule: target shape is exactly the peer shape and must be broadcast compatible
semantics.dtype_rule: input dtype is preserved and peer dtype is irrelevant
semantics.accumulation_dtype: f32 for VJP and not applicable to forward
semantics.device_rule: input and peer device and stream must agree
semantics.numeric_rule: no forward arithmetic and deterministic broadcast-gradient sums
semantics.tolerance: bit exact forward and 1e-6 f32 gradients
semantics.cancellation_points: before peer validation and before returning the view
semantics.vjp_rule: Task 63 sums broadcast axes into the source shape
semantics.jvp_rule: Task 63 broadcasts the tangent to the peer shape
